source.notes: Dense March drone footage supports seven Chiba bays, internal stepped access, 20 solar modules and parallel Rotapolis with one tall and one low bay. Five travel trailers are individually placed. Exact interbuilding spacing and hidden room boundaries remain under photographic calibration.
limitations: Rack bays set to nominal 12 ft. Photographic placement is approximate; this is not a measured inventory or survey.

bands.note: low prisms = geometry within the ground body band; .up = above it (overhead). No walkable decks/stairs: none are declared by the procedural scene.
